prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Conroe, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1109; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my name on a recording right now, but you can use the claim reference.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where the accident happened?

A: It was at an intersection in Conroe, Texas. I was going through a four-way intersection on a green light when another car came in from my right side.

Q: Which direction were you traveling, and what happened next?

A: I was heading north. The other vehicle was coming from the east and didn't stop for its red light. It hit the driver's side of my car, right in the door area.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Only for a second. I had just started to move into the intersection, and I saw the car coming, but there was no time to swerve.

Q: Were you wearing a seatbelt, and did the airbags deploy?

A: Yes, I was belted. The side airbag went off, and the car spun a little before it stopped.

Q: Did you go to a doctor or hospital after the accident?

A: I was taken to the emergency room that night. My right knee took most of the impact against the center console and door frame. They did X-rays and said there was no fracture, but the knee is swollen and I can't bend it fully.

Q: Have you seen an orthopedic specialist or started any treatment since then?

A: I have an appointment with an orthopedist next week. I've been using ice and a brace, and I'm taking prescribed pain medication.

Q: Is there anything else you think I should know about the accident?

A: Only that I had the green light, and there was a witness who stopped at the corner. I can give you that person's contact information later.

Q: Thank you. We'll follow up with you once we've reviewed the information.

A: Okay, thank you.
